business_problem: Document360 needed its Eddy AI assistant to answer multi-part documentation questions accurately without breaking access controls or adding a separate vector database to keep in sync.
solution_summary: Document360 kept its knowledge-base AI stack on MongoDB by pairing MongoDB Vector Search on Atlas with Atlas Search and Voyage AI instead of replicating data into a separate vector store. The platform already served as a single source of truth for enterprise documentation and relied on detailed content permissions baked into MongoDB. When the Eddy AI assistant began handling more complex multi-intent prompts, small wording changes frequently pulled the wrong context and undermined customer trust. Rather than duplicate documents and permissions elsewhere, Document360 stored vectors in Atlas beside the source content and used hybrid keyword plus semantic search to retrieve the right passages natively. Voyage AI powers the embedding side of the stack, while Atlas keeps access controls and search in one governed platform. This gives Eddy low-latency retrieval, more reliable answers, and a simpler operational model for enterprise documentation use cases.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores Document360's governed documentation corpus and the permissions model Eddy depends on.

solution_components.name: Atlas Search
solution_components.role: Supplies keyword retrieval that Document360 combines with semantic matching for hybrid search.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Vector Search on Atlas
solution_components.role: Performs semantic retrieval over documentation embeddings for Eddy's AI responses.

solution_components.name: Voyage AI
solution_components.role: Generates the embeddings Document360 uses for semantic search.

data_flow: Documentation content and permissions remain in MongoDB Atlas, Voyage AI generates embeddings for that content, Atlas Search and MongoDB Vector Search on Atlas run hybrid retrieval against the same governed corpus, and Eddy uses the retrieved passages to answer complex user questions with low latency.
business_outcome: Document360 raised baseline AI accuracy to 94%, reduced user dislikes by 30%, and achieved 2-4 millisecond retrieval times while keeping access controls and content synchronization simple.
metrics: The unified architecture boosted baseline response accuracy to 94%, reduced user dislikes by 30%, and ensured 2-4-millisecond return times.
